name: United Explorer Credit Card

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: $0 intro annual fee for the first year, then $150

apr.notes: 19.74% to 29.99% variable APR. APR formula: Min of (6.75+12.99) and 29.99% to Min of (6.75+21.49) and 29.99% variable.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees. Purchases made with your Explorer Card outside the U.S. will not be subject to foreign transaction fees.

credit_required.notes: Not explicitly stated on the product page.

categories.label: Hotel stays booked with the hotel

rewards.redemption_notes: Miles redeemable through United MileagePlus program. Save 10% or more when booking flights with miles.

signup_bonus.description: Earn up to 60,000 bonus miles: 50,000 bonus miles after you spend $3,000 on purchases in the first 3 months your account is open, plus 10,000 bonus miles after you add an authorized user in the first 3 months.

benefits.title: Free First Checked Bag
benefits.description: The primary Cardmember and one companion can each check a first standard bag for free - save up to $200 per roundtrip.

benefits.title: 2 United Club One-Time Passes Per Year
benefits.description: 2 United Club one-time passes per year - over a $100 value. Relax in comfort while waiting for your flight with complimentary beverages, snacks, high-speed Wi-Fi and more.

benefits.title: Priority Boarding
benefits.description: The primary Cardmember and companions on the same reservation will be invited to board United-operated flights prior to general boarding.

benefits.title: 10,000-Mile Award Flight Discount
benefits.description: Earn a 10,000-mile award flight discount after spending $20,000 each calendar year to use toward an eligible award flight.

benefits.title: Global Entry / TSA Precheck / NEXUS Credit
benefits.description: Up to $120 as a statement credit for Global Entry, TSA Precheck or NEXUS every 4 years as reimbursement for the application fee when charged to your card.

benefits.title: 25% Back on Inflight Purchases
benefits.description: 25% back as a statement credit on purchases of food, beverages and Wi-Fi on board United-operated flights and on Club premium drinks when you pay with your Explorer Card.

benefits.title: $100 United Travel Credit
benefits.description: Earn a $100 United travel credit after you spend $10,000 with your United Explorer Card within a calendar year.

benefits.title: Up to $100 in Prepaid Hotel Credits
benefits.description: Receive up to $100 in credits annually on prepaid hotel stays purchased directly through United Hotels with your United Explorer Card.

benefits.title: Up to $60 in Rideshare Credits
benefits.description: Enroll to receive up to $60 in credits each calendar year on rideshare purchases when paying with your United Explorer Card.

benefits.title: Up to $50 in Avis/Budget Car Rental Credits
benefits.description: Receive up to $50 in United travel credits annually when you book Avis or Budget car rentals directly through cars.united.com and pay with your United Explorer Card.

benefits.title: Up to $120 in Instacart Credits
benefits.description: Receive up to $120 in Instacart credits each calendar year for purchases made directly through Instacart with your United Explorer Card. Terms apply.

benefits.title: Up to $100 in JSX Flight Credits
benefits.description: Receive up to $100 in credits annually on flights purchased directly through JSX with your United Explorer Card.

benefits.title: Visa Signature Concierge Service
benefits.description: Get complimentary Visa Signature Concierge Service 24 hours a day.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: Purchases made with your Explorer Card outside the U.S. will not be subject to foreign transaction fees.

lounge_access.notes: 2 United Club one-time passes per year

travel_perks.free_checked_bags: Free first checked bag for primary cardmember and one companion - save up to $200 per roundtrip
other: 10,000-mile award flight discount after $20,000 spend per calendar year
25% back on inflight food, beverages and Wi-Fi on United flights
Over $500 in annual partner credits (United travel, prepaid hotels, rideshare, Avis/Budget, Instacart, JSX)

notes: Visa Signature card (confirmed via Visa Signature Concierge Service reference and United Visa Card Program Information on page). Network corrected from mastercard/world to visa/signature based on page text. APR range 19.74%-29.99% variable. No foreign transaction fees. Signup bonus up to 60,000 miles (50K after $3K spend + 10K after adding authorized user).
